title: aciphylla simplicifolia
intro: Aciphylla simplicifolia, commonly known as New Zealand angelica or parsnip wood, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is a type of giant buttercup, known for its edible and medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in treating various conditions such as digestive issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Aciphylla simplicifolia include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
